original_answer.example_en: I missed the alarm because my phone was on silent.
original_answer.example_zh: 手机设成静音，我没听到闹钟提醒。
original_answer.usage_note: miss the alarm在此指未听见或未注意到提醒；不表示错过预约。

prior_author_answer.example_en: I didn't hear my alarm this morning and overslept.
prior_author_answer.example_zh: 今天早上我没听到闹钟，结果睡过头了。
prior_author_answer.usage_note: miss the alarm表示没有听到或注意到闹钟提醒；更常说not hear your alarm或sleep through your alarm。手机静音模式不一定影响闹钟。

revised_answer.example_en: I missed my alarm this morning and overslept.
revised_answer.example_zh: 今天早上我没听到闹钟，结果睡过头了。
revised_answer.usage_note: miss your alarm意为没听见或没注意到闹钟提醒；更常见的说法还有sleep through your alarm或not hear your alarm。手机静音不一定会使闹钟静音。

original_answer.example_en: I turned on the alarm for six thirty tomorrow morning.
original_answer.example_zh: 我打开了明早六点半的闹钟。
original_answer.usage_note: turn on the alarm在手机场景中可指启用已有闹钟；设定新时间更常说set an alarm。

prior_author_answer.example_en: I switched my 6:30 alarm on for tomorrow morning.
prior_author_answer.example_zh: 我启用了明早六点半的闹钟。
prior_author_answer.usage_note: turn an alarm on指启用已有闹钟；set an alarm通常指设定提醒时间。
